1  HARSH COMPLEX, B H ROAD  SHIVAMOOGA  POLICY NO. 603702/31/10/6200001547,
 VALID UPTO 29-04-2010 TO 28-04-2011  ...RESPONDENTS (BY R1 - V/O DTD: 04.08.2015;
 SRI. S.SRISHAILA.,ADVOCATE FOR R2)
 THIS MFA IS FILED U/S 173(1) OF MV ACT AGAINST THE JUDGMENT AND AWARD DATED12.6.2012 PASSED IN MVC NO.604/2011 ON THE FILE OF THE PRESIDING OFFICER, FAST TRACK COURT-II, MACT, SHIMOGA,
PARTLY ALLOWING THE CLAIM PETITION FOR COMPENSATION AND SEEKING ENHANCEMENT OF COMPENSATION.

THIS APPEAL, COMING ON FOR DISMISSAL, THIS DAY, THE COURT DELIVERED THE FOLLOWING:
 JUDGMENT
When the matter came up on 06.10.2023, there was no representation on behalf of both the parties and the matter was directed to posted for dismissal on 10.10.2023.
Even on 10.10.2023, there was no representation on behalf of both the parties.
Hence the matter was directed to be listed today.
This is an appeal filed by the claimant where the tribunal had fixed the liability on the owner of the vehicle.
Appeal against respondent No.1 was dismissed as per the cause list.
It appears that claimant is not interested to pursue the matter.
3. Accordingly the appeal is dismissed for non- prosecution.
